Sources preserved in this development fork:

- RLinf-dexterous-hands 0.1.0 from the rlinf container, Apache-2.0 (LICENSE).
- retargeting/tier2_optimizer.py, robot_pinocchio.py, reference vector construction,
  skeleton offsets and assets copied from psi-glove-air2wuji-hand on 2026-09-11.
  Algorithm changes are limited to import paths and separating ROS transport.
- assets/wuji/LICENSE retains the Wuji model license. Glove URDF and calibration
  data retain their upstream content; verify redistribution rights before publishing.
- The internal psiglove_1/2 names identify 21/22-value protocol layouts, not vendor generations.
